# Adelaide Tiling & Waterproofing — Ellis Services Group

> Ellis Services Group provides waterproofing, wall and floor tiling, shower leak assessment and tile repairs for Adelaide properties. 本站为 Ellis Services Group 的阿德莱德防水与贴砖网站，提供中英文服务说明、施工指南及联系入口。

English and Simplified Chinese pages cover the same business. The service-area overview identifies the locations we serve; contact us to confirm your property and the written scope. 英文与简体中文页面介绍同一业务；具体服务地区见区域总览，项目范围通过评估及书面报价确认。

Phone / 电话: 0425 170 688. Email / 邮箱: handyman.lyric@outlook.com.

## English services

- [Waterproofing services](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/waterproofing-adelaide.html): Choose the relevant wet area, balcony, roof or pool service and compare membrane-system roles.
- [Tiling services](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/services.html): Find installation, repair and outdoor tiling services by surface, material and location.
- [Bathroom waterproofing](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/bathroom-waterproofing-adelaide.html): Bathroom bases, under-tile membranes, junctions, penetrations and coordinated tiling.
- [Balcony waterproofing](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html): Assess balcony leaks, drainage, thresholds and exterior under-tile waterproofing.
- [Roof waterproofing](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html): Assess roof water entry, existing surfaces, membrane details and exposed-system protection.
- [Pool waterproofing](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/pool-waterproofing-adelaide.html): Pool-interior preparation and permanent-immersion systems, separate from pool surround tiling.
- [Bathroom tiling](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html): Porcelain floors, ceramic walls, mosaic niches, drainage falls and edge finishing.
- [Kitchen splashback tiling](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/kitchen-splashback-tiling-adelaide.html): Subway, porcelain and mosaic splashbacks, layout, outlet cuts and benchtop junctions.
- [Floor tiling](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/floor-tiling-adelaide.html): Floor-rated tile selection, base preparation, large-format layout and height transitions.
- [Shower leak assessment and repair](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/shower-leak-repair-adelaide.html): Distinguish joint repairs, membrane work and separate plumbing sources before choosing the repair scope.
- [Tile repairs and replacement](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/tile-repair-adelaide.html): Assess damaged or loose tiles, matching availability, base repairs and replacement boundaries.

## 中文服务

- [防水服务总览](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/waterproofing-adelaide.html): 按湿区、阳台、屋面或泳池选择对应服务，了解防水系统各层材料的作用。
- [贴砖服务总览](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/services.html): 按表面、材料与位置查找铺装、维修及户外贴砖服务。
- [浴室防水](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/bathroom-waterproofing-adelaide.html): 浴室基层、瓷砖下防水膜、交接节点、穿管及后续贴砖衔接。
- [阳台防水](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/balcony-waterproofing-adelaide.html): 评估阳台渗漏、排水、门槛及室外瓷砖下防水系统。
- [屋面防水](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/roof-waterproofing-adelaide.html): 评估屋面进水、原有表面、防水节点与外露系统保护。
- [泳池防水](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/pool-waterproofing-adelaide.html): 池内基层与长期浸水防水系统，和泳池周边贴砖分开明确范围。
- [浴室贴砖](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/bathroom-tiling-adelaide.html): 瓷质地砖、陶瓷墙砖、马赛克壁龛、排水坡度与边缘收口。
- [厨房防溅墙贴砖](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/kitchen-splashback-tiling-adelaide.html): 地铁砖、瓷质砖与马赛克防溅墙，安排排砖、插座切割及台面接缝。
- [室内地面贴砖](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/floor-tiling-adelaide.html): 地面适用砖材、基层处理、大规格排版及相邻完成面高差。
- [淋浴漏水评估与维修](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/shower-leak-repair-adelaide.html): 区分接缝维修、防水膜工作及独立水管来源，再确认修复范围。
- [瓷砖维修与更换](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/tile-repair-adelaide.html): 评估破损或松动瓷砖、配砖条件、基层修补及更换范围。

- [Timber flooring service and Gouger Street project](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/timber-flooring-adelaide.html): Flooring preparation and installation scope, with photographs of the recorded February 2026 interior timber project.
- [木地板服务与 Gouger Street 项目](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/timber-flooring-adelaide.html): 木地板基层与安装范围，以及已记录的2026年2月室内木地板项目照片。
- [Tile materials and finishes guide](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/tile-materials-finishes-guide.html): Distinguish tile bodies, finishes and formats; compare wet-floor, wall and kitchen uses and care.
- [瓷砖材料与饰面指南](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/tile-materials-finishes-guide.html): 区分砖体、表面与形式，比较湿态地面、墙面及厨房用途和养护。
- [Waterproofing materials and systems guide](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/waterproofing-materials-systems-guide.html): Membranes, primers, joint materials, exposure, immersion, film thickness and curing as a complete system.
- [防水材料与系统指南](https://www.adelaidetilingandwaterproofing.com.au/zh/waterproofing-materials-systems-guide.html): 结合完整系统理解防水膜、底涂、节点材料、外露、浸水、膜厚与养护。
